services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: 🐚 Is your crew seeking the opportunity to explore the beautiful waters of Hatteras? When you’re the captain you choose the adventure - clamming, fishing, shelling, cruising or even anchoring up to a secluded sandbar! 🐟 According to North Carolina wild life law, any person born on or after January 1st, 1988 must successfully complete a NASBLA approved boating course before operating any of our vessels. A guided tutorial is included and mandatory to acquaint the operator with the channel and surrounding area. services.name: Hatteras Parasail
services.desc: Our parasailing adventure takes place on the sound side of Hatteras Village. You will get to enjoy the spectacular views of Hatteras Village, while flying above the Pamlico Sound for 10-12 minutes. When parasailing, the riders are put in a life vest and a harness that is attached to the parachute. Riders are then instructed to take a seated position on the platform. As the boat increases speed, the parachute slowly takes flight. Once you are off the platform, you no longer need to hold the harness.
